item.title: Chof Beis Shvat: The Rebbetzin’s Yartzeit
item.description: The 22nd of Shvat marks the yahrtzeit of Rebbetzin Chaya Mushkah Schneerson, wife of the Lubavitcher Rebbe. An erudite and wise woman, she carried the mantle of her revered position in a humble and unpretentious fashion. COLlive presents customs, Mishnayos and videos to mark the day. Full Story, Photos, Video
